report_only.summary: Controlled 50-iteration baseline MLP/RLlib run with online_sensor documented in reports; current run folder is not present under runs/training.
Stabilized RLlib MLP training reached a real 50-iteration run with checkpoints, TensorBoard, and finite metrics.
First full-gait hybrid MLP diagnostic training; useful for GRF hybrid architecture decisions, not a final imitation baseline.
Overnight hybrid run timed out around iterations 41-43; best/last checkpoints were usable for rollout diagnostics.
First long imitation training with sound-leg anti-phase reward; native Ray crash occurred and was resumed from checkpoint.
V4 C2/jerk-limited imitation training line before reward normalization; current tracked folders cover the obs-target and reward-normalized continuation.
